articleTitle: A Dual-Pathway Current Measurement and Control Scheme for Flat-Top Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Accurate sampling and control of high currents play a crucial role in the realization of flat-top pulsed magnetic fields, directly determining the stability and precision of the magnetic field. Traditional current sampling schemes simultaneously collect all components of the load current, including AC (alternating current) and DC (direct current) components. These components are then amplified and filtered as a whole, with the filtered result serving as the control reference. Such sampling schemes impose significant challenges on the performance of current sensors, including range, bandwidth, and resolution. Additionally, filtering can cause distortion of the high-frequency components in the measurement results, affecting waveform quality. This paper proposes an innovative current measurement and control method based on the skin effect. A dual-pathway shunt is used to separate the DC and AC components of the load current. The AC components are amplified separately and used as the control variable to achieve stability control of the load current. This paper details the working principle and design method of the dual-pathway shunt, theoretically demonstrates its effectiveness, and further verifies the feasibility of the method through simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Synchronization Control of Complex Systems with Unknown Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Synchronization behavior is one of the most important characteristics of system. However, in practice, it is impossible to know all the system parameters, which increases the difficulty of network synchronization control. Thus, a controller is designed to achieve network synchronization based on the pinning control method, the extended state observer theory and the backstepping sliding mode control method. First, an extended state observer is designed to observe the uncertain variables. Second, a pinning controller is designed to realize network synchronization based on the backstepping sliding mode control. Finally, the simulation of a random 30-node Lorenz chaotic network verifies the correctness of this method.

articleTitle: Low Voltage Stress and Zero Current Ripple based on Integrated LLC and Partial Power Processing Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a LLC resonant and partial power processing integrated converter to realize the reduction of stress to the components in the second stage and the increase in the whole switching efficiency. Meanwhile, the first stage applies a interleaved structure to realize zero input current ripple. On one hand, the given topology solves the problem of reducing efficiency and difficulty in magnetic component design. On the other hand, it significantly reduces the stress of switching elements of the second stage, lowering the cost for the system. Through theory analysis and simulation, the validity of proposed structure is verified, and the effectiveness and practicability are illustrated through the experiment.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Brushless Doubly-Fed Machines with Different Rotor Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Brushless doubly fed machine (BDFM) has different rotors, i.e. salient-pole, multilayer flux barrier, short-circuit winding. However, there is no comparative analysis on the performances of the different rotor types. So, this paper studies their differences from both the analytical equations and finite element analysis (FEA). First, the basic structure and working principle of BDFMs are introduced. Subsequently, under the same stator core and armature winding, the excitation magnetomotive force (MMF), airgap flux density, and torque of the three rotors are analytically derived and compared. Finally, based on FEA, the key performances including rated torque, power factor, overload torque, total harmonic distortion (THD) of line back-EMF, short-circuit current, etc. are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: A Robust Feedback Control Strategy for Parameter Mismatch in Multi-Port Magnetic Network Energy Routers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Multi-Port Magnetic Network Energy Routers (MNER) is a potential topology due to its performance in quick dynamic response, centralize control and improvement of system efficiency. However, the impact of some factors causes parameter mismatch that the performance of model-based control strategies is deteriorated. Although parameter identification is a solution providing precise parameters, it brings extra stress to the compute units. In this paper, a feedback control strategy is proposed that the error of phase-shift is fixed according to the difference between output power and reference power. The proposed strategy is robust to parameter mismatch of inductance itself. Performance of the proposed strategy is analyzed theoretically and the results of simulation verify the effect of this strategy.

articleTitle: A Crosslinking Agent Modification Method for XLPE Bilayer Interface Mechanical Strength Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Cable factory joints play a key role in XLPE submarine cable system. Nevertheless, XLPE interface has the lowest mechanical strength in the insulation layer, which will lead to the insulation crack or pore defects formation, even breakdown faults. In this work, a crosslinking agent modification method for XLPE bilayer interface mechanical strength enhancement was studied on both tablet compressing samples and real factory joints. The results show that crosslinking agent modification have the effect on XLPE interfacial mechanical strength enhancement and reduce pore defects formation.

articleTitle: A Novel Denoising Method for Ultra-High Frequency Signals of Partial Discharge in GIS/GIL
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) detection is an important means for insulation condition monitoring. The ultra-high frequency (UHF) method is commonly used for on-site PD detection in gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) and gas-insulated transmission line (GIL). However, the obvious attenuation of UHF signal and complex interference result in a low signal-to-noise ratio of PD signals, making it difficult to locate PD source. In this paper, a novel denoising method based on multi-channel correlation-average for UHF PD signals is proposed and displayed. Then, PD detection and localization in a hydropower plant is conducted. The results show that the UHF PD signal (about 5 mV) submerged in noise (about 20 mV) can be effectively extracted using the proposed denoising method. Subsequently, based on the denoised signal, the PD source was accurately located. This further validates the effectiveness of the proposed method. The research of this study provides good guidance for on-site PD detection and equipment maintenance.

articleTitle: An Improved Analytical Method for Cylindrical Permanent Magnet Eddy Current Couplers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper proposes an analytical method for calculating the characteristics of cylindrical permanent magnet eddy current couplers in a cylindrical coordinate system. For the simplified cylindrical structure of the coupler, 2D/3D electromagnetic field analytical models are established to predict magnetic field distribution, current density distribution, and torque output characteristics. The results are compared with those obtained from the finite element model, showing an error of less than 5%. A comparison between the torque output characteristics calculated in the cylindrical coordinate system and the Cartesian coordinate system indicates that the analytical method in the cylindrical coordinate system is more accurate. Under typical operating conditions, the torque output characteristics of the 3D analytical model, considering temperature correction, are compared with the experimental prototype test results, also showing an error of less than 5%. Therefore, this method allows for accurate and rapid design of cylindrical permanent magnet eddy current couplers.

articleTitle: Design of Excitation Power Supply for a 10 MVar Superconducting Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission technology and clean energy, the issue of dynamic reactive power shortage in the power grid has become increasingly serious. High-Temperature Superconducting Synchronous Condensers (HTS SC), with their low synchronous reactance and low excitation loss, offer excellent reactive power compensation performance, making them an ideal choice for modern power grids. This paper designs an excitation power supply for a 10 MVar HTS SC. Compared to traditional excitation power supplies, this design features low harmonics, bidirectional energy flow, and the capability to output a certain amount of reactive power. Additionally, a corresponding de-excitation module has been designed to address the quench challenge of superconducting field windings. The feasibility of the excitation system is verified using MATLAB/Simulink simulation software.

articleTitle: Temperature and Voltage Measurements for High Voltage Converter Testing Bench Based on Magnetic Field Energy Harvesting Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In the testing of power electronic converters, voltage and temperature are important indicators to ensure the safe operation of converters. In low-cost high-voltage converter testing, conventional test methods often fail to harmonize between cost, accuracy, and space constraints. This paper will present the application of a temperature sensor based on magnetic field energy harvesting in the testing of the above mentioned converters. Firstly, this paper introduces the working principle of the temperature sensor based on magnetic field energy harvesting, and uncovers from it the relationship between the interval time of its transmission information and the output voltage of the converter. Secondly, take the low-power high-voltage converter above 1kV as an example, describe the limitations of conventional testing methods in this converter. The arrangement of the temperature sensor based on magnetic field energy harvesting in the converter is given. The experimental results also verify the correctness of the above theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Look at the Unity of Frequency Support for Grid-Following and Grid-Forming Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Grid-connected wind turbines for frequency support of the grid is conducive to improving the grid frequency security level. Grid-following (GFL) converters and gridforming (GFM) converters are two important types of equipment to support renewable energy integration into the grid. Both GFM and GFL have a variety of different control strategies when performing frequency support. Clarifying the relationship be-tween different strategies of GFM and GFL when performing frequency support will provide guidance for renewable energy frequency support. In this paper, four levels of frequency support uniformity are first established at the generation unit level. (1) The governor and damping branch of the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control based GFM converter are unified. (2) The VSG based GFM and the droop based GFM are unified. (3) Integrated inertial control based GFL and droop based GFL are unified. Finally, the theoretical analysis is synthetically verified by MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Pulse Compaction Behavior of Sm2Co17 Magnetic Powder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Magnetic pulse compaction (MPC) is an effective method for preparation of high-performance materials because of its high compaction energy and good controllability. This paper reports the densification behavior of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sm}_{2}\text{Co}_{17}$</tex> magnetic powder under MPC. The simulation model of the MPC device was set up, and the acceleration process of the drive plate under the action of electromagnetic force was studied. The optimum process parameters of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sm}_{2}\text{Co17}$</tex> MPC were explored, and the influences of the impact energy, filling amount of magnetic powder and the acceleration distance of stamping module on compact density were studied. When the initial energy storage was 8 kJ, the filling amount of magnetic powder was 3 g, and the acceleration distance of the stamping module was 50 mm, the peak pressure of 3.02 GPa was achieved. At room temperature and without sintering, the compact with the relative density of 88.21% was obtained.

articleTitle: Design of Power Supply for FRC Plasma Thruster Driven by Pulsed RMF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The Field-reversed configuration (FRC) plasma thruster is a propulsion device driven by Pulsed Rotating magnetic field (RMF) to generate thrust. An FRC plasma thruster prototype has been built. The RMF antennas are designed with very high parameters namely a peak current of 4 kA, a resonant frequency of 150 kHz. Thus, a high voltage, high current pulsed power supply is required to satisfy the design. This article mainly presents the challenges and solutions in the design of the power supply system. First, 4 sets of power supplies are used to feed the RMF coils, which results in design parameters of 4 kA/3.5 kV for each power supply. Then, stray parameters control and loss analysis were done to improve power supply efficiency. Experimental tests are also performed on the system. In conclusion, the designed power supply system can satisfy the requirements of high operation parameters and high controllability.

articleTitle: Finite-Control-Set Model Predictive Control with Discrete Space Vector Modulation for Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Shunt Active Power Filter (SAPF), as an efficient and reliable harmonic elimination device, has found its applications in numerous industrial scenarios. Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control (FCS-MPC), leveraging its advantages such as variable decoupling and ease of incorporating various constraints, has emerged as a viable alternative for controlling grid-connected converters. However, conventional FCS-MPC eliminates the modulation component, enabling it to output only one of the eight fundamental voltage vectors within a sampling period. This characteristic leads to a dispersed output voltage spectrum, posing challenges for the application of FCS-MPC in SAPF. In this paper, FCS-MPC is incorporated into SAPF, and the modulation method of Discrete Space Vector Modulation (DSVM) is introduced to enlarge the selectable vector set. This approach effectively enhances the compensation performance of SAPF while retaining the merits of FCS-MPC. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of this methodology.

Author Keywords: Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control (FCS-MPC)

articleTitle: Monitoring Method for Pollution Class of Roof Insulators in EMUs Using Lissajous Figure and Morphologic Characters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Accurately grasping the surface pollution class (PC) of roof insulators is of great importance for the safe operation of electric multiple units (EMUs). In this paper, we propose a new method for monitoring the PC of roof insulators in EMUs. In this approach, the input voltage and the leakage current of the insulator are combined into a graph, i.e., a Lissajous figure with more characteristic information. The variation of the Lissajous figure under different factors is then studied. Digital image processing technique was used for morphological analysis of the Lissajous figure. The results show that the eccentricity of the insulator's Lissajous ellipse can be used as an effective monitoring index of the PC of roof insulators.

articleTitle: A Novel Internal Ripple Compensation Technology With DC Offset Cancellation Based on COT Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Constant on time (COT) buck converter has been widely used because of its advantage of fast transient response. Traditional ripple compensation method uses passive components and high gain-bandwidth amplifiers to enhance loop stability and improve output voltage accuracy, which leads to increased power consumption and decreased compactness. This paper proposes a novel internal ripple compensation (IRC) technology with DC offset cancellation. To enhance loop stability, IRC circuit emulates virtual ripple by using RC filter. To improve output voltage accuracy, DC offset calibration module eliminates DC offset of virtual ripple by using full-wave rectification and high-precision current operational techniques. The effectiveness of this method has been verified through cadence platform. Experimental results demonstrate that when the converter load current is 1A and the output voltage is 5V, the output voltage DC offset is reduced from 0.56<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>(28mV) to 0.12<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>(6mV).

articleTitle: Nonparametric Sliding Mode Predictive Current Control for Linear Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Model predictive control (MPC) enables the linear induction motor (LIM) drive system to maintain good performance despite large distortions in the input voltage waveform, and is particularly suitable for applications with lower converter switching frequencies, such as urban rail transit. However, the parameters of the LIM vary dramatically due to the end effect, which reduces the control performance of the MPC. This paper presents a nonparametric sliding mode predictive current control method to enhance the parametric robustness of MPC. The cost function of nonparametric current control is constructed to overcome the limitation of model predictive control, which is greatly affected by parameter accuracy. The simulation results show that the proposed method can maintain the good control performance of the LIM drive system under the condition of inaccurate parameters, effectively improve the robustness of the system, and has certain engineering significance.

articleTitle: Power Quality Complex Disturbance Identification Based on Markov Transition Field and Dual Path Net
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: At present, with the massive use of new energy sources and the diversity of loads in the power system, power quality disturbances are becoming more and more complex, and it is difficult for traditional identification methods to accurately identify complex disturbances. In order to solve this problem, a power quality composite perturbation identification method based on Markov Transition Field (MTF) and Dual Path Network (DPN) was proposed. Firstly, the Markov transfer field is used to convert the disturbance signal into a two-dimensional image training set with sufficient information and easy identification on the premise of retaining the temporal features of the disturbance signal, and then the disturbance features are extracted at a deep level through DPN, so as to identify the composite perturbation type. Through a series of comparative experiments, it is verified that MTF can retain more effective information in a smaller size and that DPN has better accuracy and robustness when processing large-scale data, and then the superiority of power quality composite perturbation identification based on MTF and DPN is verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of Discharge Characteristics and Parameter Influence of Pulsed Power Supply for Electrothermal Chemical Shotguns
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The discharge current waveform of the pulse power supply(PPS) has a direct relationship with the characteristics of the discharge load. The load of the electrothermal chemical cannon is mainly a plasma generator, which involves many complex physical processes in the discharge emission process. However, at present, fixed resistance is generally used to simulate the load for discharge, so it is impossible to accurately study the discharge characteristics of pulsed power supply to electrothermal chemical cannon. Therefore, a 560KJ PPS is initially designed in this paper, and the mathematical model of the pulse power supply and plasma generator load is established. Combined with the internal ballistic model of the electrothermal chemical gun, the model is discretized by the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method, and the corresponding discharge current, discharge output energy and projectile velocity curves are calculated and drawn. Based on the established mathematical model of pulse power supply for electrothermic chemical shotguns, the effects of different parameters of PPS on discharge performance are analyzed, which provides a reference for the optimization of discharge parameters of PPS.

articleTitle: Study of Fringe Field Transformations of Short Permanent Magnet Quadrupole Focusing Lens
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Quadrupole magnet is an important element in the beam transport and manipulation. Permanent magnet quadrupole (PMQ) lenses appear frequently in various beamline attributed to their compact structure. In this paper, a method applicable to the fringing field transformation of a short permanent magnet quadrupole lens is proposed. The large electron beam envelope error, which occurs during the focusing process of short PMQ lenses, has been addressed. This achieved by replacing sharp cut-off fringing field with multi-rectangle cut-off fringing field. The causes of fringe field transformation errors are investigated by theoretical calculations of beam dynamics. The law of magnetic field gradient curve change of a short PMQ lens is analyzed. The scale parameters in the multi-rectangle approximation method are optimized by multi-particle tracking and finite element simulation. Applying the method to PMQ lenses of varying mechanical lengths confirms the feasibility and universality of the multi-rectangle approximation method for PMQ fringe field transformation.

articleTitle: Small-Signal Stability Analysis of Parallel Grid-Connected System with Grid-Forming Converter and Grid-Following Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to guarantee the stable operation of new energy sources when connected to the power system through converters, it is of paramount importance to conduct thorough research the small-signal stability of parallel grid-connected system with grid-forming converter (GFM) and grid-following converter (GFL). Initially, the state-space small-signal model of the parallel grid-connected system with GFM and GFL are derived. Subsequently, the impact of the phase-locked loop (PLL) bandwidth, virtual inertia, and reactive power loop integral coefficient on system stability is assessed using the eigenvalue locus method. Moreover, the participation factor analysis method is employed to identify the dominant state variables of the oscillatory mode. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is validated using PLECS.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Control Grid on the Emission Characteristics of Cathode Assembly
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Low-energy electron curtain accelerators are widely used in the field of radiation processing. In this paper, the model of the cathode emission assembly of the multi-filament electron curtain accelerator is established by CST simulation software, and the influence of the duty ratio and grid width of the semi-cylindrical control grid on the current emission characteristics of the cathode assembly is explored. It is found that the larger the duty ratio of the control grid and the wider the mesh grid width, the emission current and the current drawn at control grid increase. Especially when the width of mesh grid reaches 3mm, the current emission characteristics of the cathode assembly no longer conform to the three-half law. The research work in this paper has reference significance for the construction and design of cathode assembly.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on Spatiotemporal Attention Convolutional Networks under Weather-free Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the massive integration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) systems into the power grid, accurate forecasting of distributed PV power generation is of great significance for the stable operation of power systems. Existing methods often neglect the spatiotemporal correlations among distributed PV systems, making it difficult to effectivelyutilize spatiotemporal feature information to improve power forecasting accuracy. Considering the strong spatiotemporal correlations among distributed PV outputs and the difficulty in obtaining meteorological data, this paper proposes a distributed PV power forecasting method based on Spatial- Time-Attention, Graph Convolutional Network (GCN), and Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). This method achieves accurate PV power prediction under weather-free conditions based solely on historical power data. First, the spatial-time attention mechanism is used to extract the spatiotemporal dependencies of the distributed PV cluster output. Next, GCN and TCN are utilized to construct a spatiotemporal graph convolutional network for prediction training, obtaining the forecasting results. Finally, a simulation is conducted based on real data from a distributed PV power plant in a certain region of China. The case study results show that the proposed model has higher accuracy compared to traditional deep learning models.

articleTitle: Research on Variable-Frequency Harmonic Estimation Algorithm of Pulse Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The tokamak pulse power supply system has a large amount of impulse reactive power and harmonics, which can occupy a large amount of pulse generator's limited capacity. The characteristics of pulse generator lead to a significant variation in the pulse signal frequency, with the fundamental harmonic varying over a range of up to 30 Hz or even more. In this paper, an improved algorithm based on the continuous wavelet transform (CWT) is proposed, which can be used to perform an effective time-frequency analysis of variable-frequency harmonics in the pulse power supply system. The harmonic results are calculated by simulating the variable-frequency distorted voltage and current waveforms from the pulse generator. Comparison with the theoretical values, the results show that the proposed multi-scale feature integration continuous wavelet algorithm(MSFI-CWT) can effectively analyze the variable-frequency distortion voltage and current signals. The MSFI-CWT proposed can be used as a reference for the reactive power and harmonic analysis of tokamak pulse power supply system.

articleTitle: Research on Two-Stage DC-DC Converter Suitable for High Voltage Input and Low Voltage Output
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, a two-stage DC-DC converter topology is proposed to tackle the challenges of wide input range and high voltage levels in vehicle-mounted DC buses. A three-level Buck (TL Buck) converter is utilized as the front stage, thereby reducing the voltage stress on the MOSFETs to half of the input voltage. This makes it suitable for applications with high voltage levels and wide input ranges. Additionally, a star-connected three-phase LLC is employed as the rear stage to minimize output current ripple and achieve zero voltage switching (ZVS) and zero current switching (ZCS). A cascaded loop control with fixed frequency modulation strategy is adopted, demonstrating strong adaptability to wide input voltages. Finally, a simulation model is constructed to verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed topology and control strategy.

articleTitle: Efficiency Modelling and Analysis of Electrolysis System in Hydrogen-Producing Offshore Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Hydrogen-producing offshore wind turbine (HP-OWT) become an emerging solution for wind power services in offshore scenarios. By integrating the green hydrogen production into the DC link of the HP-OWT, the grid power can be adjusted. The fluctuating wind power may influence the power conversion efficiency of the electrolysis system. This paper studies the electrolysis power conversion efficiency in HP-OWT for grid-injected power smoothing service. The power conversion efficiency model considering converter and electrolysis is first established. Furthermore, the impact of wind fluctuations on efficiency is analyzed. The analysis results show that the efficiency of electrolysis system power conversion can be affected by the amplitude and frequency of wind fluctuation. The power conversion efficiency decreases with the increase of power fluctuation. The analysis results can be applied for efficiency optimization and control of HP-OWT.

articleTitle: An Efficiency Improvement Strategy for Hydrogen-Producing Offshore Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Hydrogen-producing offshore wind turbine (HP-OWT) represents a highly promising approach for efficient offshore wind power harvesting, with its power smoothed by green hydrogen production. The fluctuating power is shared by the electrolysis system and the power grid. The power conversion efficiency is an important index of the HP-OWT performance. Therefore, this article aims to illustrate the impacts of power fluctuation on both the converters and the electrolysis system and propose an efficiency improvement strategy. The power conversion efficiency model of HP-OWT considering the dynamic response is established. Then, the impact of power fluctuation on the HP-OWT is studied. It has been found that the power conversion efficiency in HP-OWT can be damaged by totally sending the fluctuating power into the electrolysis system. An efficiency improvement strategy based on power averaging is proposed. The simulation validation shows that the proposed efficiency improvement strategy is effective in HP-OWT.

articleTitle: ZVS Control For a GaN-Based CRM Totem-Pole PFC Converter With ZCD
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a detailed analysis of a single-phase GaN-based power factor correction (PFC) critical-conduction-mode (CRM) totem-pole rectifier with zero-voltage-switching (ZVS) control. The paper thoroughly derives the ZVS strategy for full-line periodic zero-voltage switching and introduces a double-closed-loop analytical converter model integrated with a real-time calculation module. A critical aspect of ZVS implementation is the zero-current detection (ZCD) module. Thus, the paper provides a detailed analysis of ZCD signal delays and performs quantitative calculations to compensate for these delays. Both a simulation model and a small power prototype are developed and tested. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed control strategy effectively achieves CRM totem-pole zero-voltage-switching.

articleTitle: PV Power Forecasting Based on VMD-RIME-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Addressing the challenges posed by the strong nonlinearity and numerous influencing factors of PV power data, this study proposes a novel combined forecasting method that integrates the Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD) and the frost-ice optimization algorithm (RIME) with the Long- and Short-Term Memory neural network (LSTM). Initially, the historical PV power data is decomposed using VMD to break down the complex, non-linear time series into simpler components. Subsequently, the parameters of the LSTM neural network are optimized using the RIME algorithm, which enhances the network's ability to model and predict the decomposed data effectively. Each decomposed time series component is then input into the LSTM neural network individually. The predicted values of each component are subsequently aggregated to obtain the final predicted time series values. The experiment utilizes actual PV power data from a 250MW PV power plant located in a region in the northern hemisphere. By comparing and analyzing the performance of the standalone LSTM model and the VMD-LSTM model, it is demonstrated that the proposed VMD-RIME-LSTM model significantly enhances forecasting accuracy. The results indicate that this combined approach effectively addresses the inherent complexities of PV power forecasting and showcases substantial potential for practical application in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Control Delay Compensation of Three-Level Synchronous SVPWM Based on Smith Predictor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: High-speed and high-power motor drive systems are critical for applications such as electric vehicles and industrial automation. These systems often utilize synchronous space vector pulse width modulation (SSVPWM) strategies to optimize performance. However, the multi-mode synchronous SVPWM will bring about a sudden change in the phase angle due to the switching of the number of pulses. This paper proposes a method employing the Smith predictor to correct phase and amplitude errors caused by digital control delays. Compared with the existing methods, this method can respond to phase error more quickly, especially at low carrier ratio, thus improving the stability and performance of the system.

Author Keywords: Synchronized space vector pulse width modulation (SSVPWM)

articleTitle: Research on Quasistatic Cavity Wireless Constant Current Charging System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: As a new approach, Quasi-Static Cavity Resonant Wireless Power Transfer Technology (QSCR-WPT) offers significant advantages over other wireless charging methods. It has numerous advantages such as longer transmission distances, broader coverage areas, and excellent safety characteristics. These features make it highly suitable for supplying power to devices in smart homes, smart factories, and similar environments. Recently research primarily focuses on optimizing cavity structures without detailed analysis of how variations in the load affect system transmission efficiency and capability. In addition, it doesn't explore achieving constant voltage and current. This paper analyzes the structure and operation principles of a PI-mode QSCR wireless charging system. It also optimizes the cavity structure and parameters using coupling mode theory, in addition explores a circuit topology (S-S-P topology) from a circuit perspective to achieve constant current charging in the cavity. The ultimate goal is to develop a new QSCR charging system structure capable of wide-load constant current wireless charging at multiple positions.

articleTitle: Temperature and DC Electrical Field Strength Effect on Volumetric Conductivity of Epoxy Impregnated Paper
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The extra-high voltage converter valve side bushings is key equipment in UHV DC transmission project, which run under high voltage and high current. The epoxy impregnated paper composite insulation system as its main insulation also has salient change in its electrical properties due to long-term operation under complicated working conditions, which has great impact on the insulation status of the valve side bushing. Therefore, this paper focuses on the volumetric conductivity of two epoxy impregnated paper samples that one is sprayed insulation paint and the other is not under different temperature and DC electric field strength combination test condition based on polarization and depolarization current method(PDC). The results show that increasing temperature and DC electric field strength both lead to increase of epoxy impregnated paper volumetric conductivity. The effect of temperature on volumetric conductivity is weakened by DC electric field strength. In addition, spraying insulation paint leads to the volumetric conductivity of the epoxy impregnated paper decrease significantly. The volumetric conductivity decrease varies under different combinations of DC electric field strength and temperature.

articleTitle: Torque Optimization of Six-Phase Arcuate Sine + Third Harmonic Shaping Surface Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To increase the torque density of direct-drive surface permanent-magnet synchronous motors (SPSMs), the model of arcuate sine + third harmonic (3rd) shaping SPSM with parallel magnetization and the optimal <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{3rd}$</tex> current when the machine loaded with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> current are derived. The finite-element (FE) models of six-phase arcuate <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> shaping and sine shaping SPSMs are established based on the principle of the same maximum permanent-magnet (PM) thickness, and their air-gap flux densities under no-load are compared. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> current and sine current are applied to the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> shaping and sine shaping motors, respectively, based on the principle of equal current amplitude. The results show that the amplitude of air-gap flux density fundamental wave under no load condition of the Sine shaping SPSM is significantly lower than that of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> shaping SPSM, and the amplitude of other higher harmonics is unchanged except for the third harmonic. When a rated load is applied, the average torque of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> shaping SPSM loaded with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> current is increased by 17.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> compared with the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Sine}+3\text{rd}$</tex> shaping SPSM which is only loaded with the sine current mentioned above, and is increased by 26.5% compared with the sine shaping motor. The result is consistent with the theoretical calculation and provides theoretical guidance for torque optimization of direct-drive SPSMs.

articleTitle: Helicon Plasma Source for the Field-Reversed Configuration Plasma Thruster
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A helicon plasma source for the Field-Reversed Configuration (FRC) plasma thruster is designed and developed to provide the initial plasma. A quartz tube chamber with 0.3 cm in thickness is used, which has a length of 55.5 cm and a diameter of 10 to 17 cm. Helicon plasma is produced at 13.56 MHz radio frequency (RF) power using a helical antenna with argon as the working gas. The diagnostic equipment includes homemade Langmuir three-probes, a professional camera and a current probe. The density peak in helicon plasma can be measured in this device at low axial magnetic fields of 0–120 Gs. Otherwise, the blue core appears in the center of the plasma when the magnetic field is above 1000 Gs and RF power is more than 1000 W.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Seaport Microgrid with Ship Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The necessity for renewable energy and efficiency has increased due to the increase in energy demand and limited resources. Increasing energy demand in seaports makes microgrid design essential for sustainable development. The design of micro grids is crucial to achieving energy interconnection, optimizing energy utilization, and enhancing grid resili-ence. These technologies improve power system flexibility and optimize seaport operations. Ship loads demonstrate significant volatility and uncertainty. This volatility necessitates a power system capable of flexible response. The design of the seaport micro grid should take into account the characteristics of ship loads to achieve efficient energy management. Fluctuations in ship loads impact the stability of the power system. Ship loads are classified into constant, variable, dynamic, and pulse loads. A seaport microgrid system for ship loads has been built in MATLAB-Simulink to analyze voltage stability. The fluctuation of the 10 kV AC bus voltage for the impact of ship loads, the uncertainty of power generation, and symmetrical faults (LLLG) have been analyzed. The distribution static synchronous com-pensator (DSTATCOM) has been incorporated into the grid to improve voltage stability, and its role has been analyzed.

articleTitle: A Current Prediction Control Strategy of PMSM Based on Dynamic Current Trajectory Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To enhance the performance of dynamic current and speed response of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), a dynamic current trajectory planning method is proposed. This method is combined with the deadbeat-based predictive current control (DPCC) of the PMSM. First, the bi-directional depth-first search (Bi-DFS) algorithm is employed to determine the optimal current trajectory in the dq-axis plane of the PMSM. Subsequently, utilizing the voltage vector hexagon and current sampling data, the current vector hexagon is forecasted. By adjusting the predicted current based on the planned trajectory as a reference, the current is optimized to align with the intended trajectory, ensuring effective current closed-loop control. This approach offers improved speed and accuracy in dynamic current response compared to conventional control methods, while also exhibiting robust steady-state performance. Simulation comparisons with traditional methods validate the efficacy of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Stochastic Magnetization Model Based on Copula Theory Accounting for Magnetic Material Variability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Manufacturing defects can introduce uncertainty in the magnetic properties of electrical steel, necessitating stochastic modelling of magnetization curves. The interdependence among input parameters in magnetization modelling is often overlooked. Therefore, this study proposes a stochastic modelling method for magnetization curves based on copula theory, which accounts for the dependencies among the input parameters. First, the three input parameters are identified, and their optimal marginal distributions are determined. Then, the correlation structure these parameters is constructed using Copula theory. The stochastic modelling based on Copula theory is finally verified by numerical experiments, reflecting the correlation between the parameters and generating more accurate samples of magnetization curves for electrical steel. The proposed method enhances the accuracy of magnetization modelling for electrical steel, crucial for reliability analysis and the engineering design of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Simulation of Bidirectional DC-DC Converter Based on Improved Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: At present, the braking energy recovery device of large mining vehicles cannot achieve energy recovery and reuse without bidirectional DC-DC converters. A bidirectional DC-DC converter optimization control method based on improved linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) was studied to improve the adaptability of energy storage systems in large mining vehicles to large disturbances and the response speed under the operating state of large mining vehicles. Firstly, this article discusses the topology and working principle of bidirectional DC-DC converters used in large mining cars. Then, based on the working mode and environment of bidirectional DC-DC converters in large mining cars, the improved LADRC was applied to the voltage outer loop control in the dual closed-loop control of the bidirectional DC-DC converter, and compared with the traditional PI control. The improved LADRC has added a voltage feedforward control link, further enhancing the system's adaptability to some large disturbances. Through experiments, it can be found that the improved LADRC can improve the dynamic response speed and the overall anti-interference ability of the bidirectional DC-DC converter, greatly enhancing system stability.

articleTitle: Characteristic Investigation of VFRM Multiplexed as Transformer in Integrated on-Board Charger
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Isolated on-board integrated charger (IOBIC) decreases the cost of electrical vehicles and ensures the galvanic isolation between battery and grid. This paper investigates the characteristics of the 6-stator-slots VFRMs multiplexed as transformers in IOBIC. According to the analysis, the coupling coefficient and voltage transfer ratio between two arbitrary windings of VFRMs are low, which is undesirable for a transformer. To construct the multiplexed VFRMs with high transfer characteristics, the field winding is split in this paper to build a new winding that is tightly coupled with phase winding. The voltage transfer ratio is improved greatly when the new winding and phase winding are multiplexed as the two sides of the transformer. Further, the loss and efficiency of the multiplexed VFRMs with/without load are analyzed. The 6/4 multiplexed VFRM has the lowest no-load loss and highest on-load efficiency compared with that of the other three multiplexed VFRMs.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Axial Flux Machines with Different Winding Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Axial flux machine have been developed rapidly and received much attention due to its compact axial dimension. There are many kinds of structures for axial permanent magnet machines. Among them, the single-rotor dual-stator structure is very suitable for low-speed and high-torque applications due to its unique structural characteristics that the magnetic pull on the rotor is balanced. In this structure, the winding forms mainly include fractional-slot concentrated winding and integer-slot distributed winding, and different winding structures have different advantages and disadvantages. In this paper, the single-rotor dual-stator axial flux motors with different winding structures are analyzed and compared, and combining the advantages of different windings, a new winding structure is proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-Task Learning Network-Based Condition Assessment of GIS Partial Discharge: Diagnosis and Severity Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Current methods for assessing the state of partial discharge (PD) in gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) often treat the diagnosis and severity evaluation tasks independently, limiting model performance and ignoring defect types in the PD development stages. To address these issues, this paper proposed a novel multi-task network for the condition evaluation of PD. Firstly, a lightweight attention combined with an expert network module is introduced to explore the correlations between different tasks while retaining their unique features. Secondly, we incorporate a CNN-Transformer module to capture both local and global features of GIS PD signals. Lastly, we implement a dynamic weight averaging method for the multi-task network, which adaptively adjusts the loss weights via loss variation rate of each sub-task. Experimental results demonstrated the multi-task network significantly improves the GIS state assessment performance for each sub-task, advancing the development stage evaluation of PD for various insulation defects.

articleTitle: Load Dynamic Modeling for Household Induction Cooker Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Point of resonant frequency tracking is a key research problem of induction heating power supply, requiring precise descriptions that account for the physical and circuit parameters of both the winding and cookware, as well as their interactions. However, there is no model that accurately describes the load impedance of household induction cooker power supplies under dynamic conditions. To address this issue, this paper proposes a dynamic impedance model based on the eddy current field for household induction cooker power supplies. Through electromagnetic mechanism analysis, the equivalent mutual inductance between the winding and cookware, as well as equivalent eddy current impedance of cookware, are accurately calculated, and load equivalent impedance model of household induction cooker power supply is derived. The experimental results show that the proposed impedance model can accurately describe the impedance change of cooking utensils during movement.

articleTitle: State Trajectory Analysis for LLC Resonant Converter Under Phase-Shift Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The LLC resonant converter can be utilized in the new energy vessel power systems, connecting new energy sources and power batteries or daily loads. Employing a phase-shift modulation (PSM) strategy instead of pulse frequency modulation (PFM) can enhance the utilization of magnetic components and improve the power density of the converter. However, the new energy vessel power systems face the challenge of rapidly fluctuating and unpredictable propulsion loads, necessitating the LLC resonant converter to possess a swift dynamic response capability. To improve the dynamic response of a phase shift modulated LLC resonant converter, this work proposes a state trajectory based feedforward control (STFFC) strategy. The phase shift ratio under a specific load is approximately estimated through the geometric relationships of the state trajectory, and this ratio is then fed forward. The advantage of the proposed STFFC strategy is validated through comparison with traditional PI control.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of High-Q Terahertz Metamaterial Sensor Based on QPSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper designs a terahertz metamaterial sensor based on a three-metal strip structure, which can generate a fourth-order resonance with a high quality factor. Different from the traditional method of manually adjusting structural parameters to obtain the maximum quality factor, this paper utilizes the quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization (QPSO) to optimize structural parameters of the metamaterial sensor, significantly enhancing the efficiency of the optimization process. The maximum quality factor of the fourth-order resonance optimized by QPSO is as high as 58, while the peak height is greater than 0.8. When an analyte layer with a thickness of 20 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> is covered onto the sensor surface, the sensing sensitivity reaches 198 GHz/RIU. The sensor can be used in high-sensitivity detection, trace biological sample detection and other fields.

articleTitle: Investigation of Segment Switching Process in High-Speed Dynamic Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In dynamic wireless power transfer (DWPT) systems, the rapid change of coupling when the receiver coil moves from one segmented transmitter coil to another may cause current overshooting or transient oscillations during the segment switching process, especially in high-speed scenarios. In this paper, these segment-switching phenomena in DWPT systems are investigated and explained in detail. The large-signal and small-signal model of a two-segmented-transmitter DWPT system is established first. The transient characters of the DWPT system under various receiver speeds and various circuit parameters including load conditions, resonant frequencies, and resonant inductors, are shown and explained. The results are validated by the comparison of the theoretical analysis and the simulation.

articleTitle: Frequency Synchronization Control of Cyber-Physical Power System Based on Pinning Synchronization Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Based on the latest research on existing cyber-physical power system, aiming at the problem that existing frequency control strategies that take into account operational uncertainties cannot achieve overall consideration of the entire system. A pinning synchronization control method is proposed based on the backstepping sliding mode control theory and adaptive control theory in this paper. Firstly, a pinning control model with external disturbance is given. Secondly, in order to achieve the pinning synchronization control of system, the synchronization controller is designed based on the backstepping sliding mode control. Finally, considering that the boundaries of uncertainties can't be directly obtained, an adaptive backstepping sliding mode synchronization controller is designed to achieve the frequency synchronization of cyber physical power system. The simulation of IEEE30-bus and IEEE39-bus cyber-physical power system verify the correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Introduction and Technical Advantage Analysis of Grid-Supporting SVG Products
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: For a long time China has built a number of thermal power, hydropower and other dominant huge AC synchronous power grid, in a long period of time, the conventional synchronous machine power supply will still be the main supportive power supply of China's power grid. With the promotion of double carbon target, the new power system construction process is accelerating, the new energy accounted for a substantial increase in the stability of the grid, especially the voltage stability problem is prominent, in the high proportion of new energy grid and other occasions, after the failure of the low-voltage and over-voltage problems are intertwined with the deterioration of the impedance characteristics of the system triggered broadband oscillation, the basic strength of the power system has been a serious challenge to limit the ability of new energy acceptance. The Grid-supporting technology can improve the system inertia and short circuit capacity, improve the short circuit ratio of new energy multi-site stations, improve the impedance characteristics of the grid, can effectively reconcile the various problems faced by the development of new energy, and is a key technology for the construction of a new type of power system.

articleTitle: Application of LQR and State Observation in Servo Motor Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: At present, the PID control based on classical control theory is widely used in the control strategy of AC servo system. PID controller has low order, and designs simply, but it has its own limitations. In recent years, many scholars have researched state feedback control based on modern control theory, this method considers performance optimum, energy optimum and other factors, which can meet design requirements of servo system.This paper takes the classic second-order model of the servo system as the controlled object, and designs an LQR optimal output feedback controller based on internal model and state observation for the system, and compares the effectiveness with traditional PI controllers. Finally, this article discretizes the controller and verifies the results in a real servo system.

articleTitle: High-Stability, Long-Duration Flat-Top Magnetic Field Generation Using a Novel Two-Stage Magnetic Compensation Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Flat-top pulsed magnetic field (FTPMF) with high stability and long duration is imperative for scientific applications such as nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and specific heat measurement. This paper introduces a novel circuit design aimed at augmenting the stability and duration of the FTPMF using a multi-capacitor power supply. It is an invasive coil paired with a quasi-two-stage circuit for precision current regulation. The current control circuit ensures the invasive coil receives an ultra-low ripple current by MOSFET operating in the active region. The front stage is a MOSFET operating in the switching state to provide a voltage envelope for the second stage, thereby reducing the voltage drop and power loss of the second stage MOSFET. Furthermore, this paper proposes a design method for optimizing circuit parameters and system controls. Finally, to verify the validity of the theory, a 20T/110 ms/85ppm experimental prototype is developed. The experimental results show that the proposed topology reduce the device heat generation, and improves the flat-top duration as 4.7 times of the conventional scheme.

articleTitle: Simulation of Influence of Plasma Conductivity Anisotropy on Electric Field Distribution in the Divertor Target Biasing Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Plasma conductivity anisotropy is realized through the rotation transformation of the coordinate axis. By obtaining the magnetic field distribution, a conductivity anisotropic conductor model is established. The ability of target biasing in different bias modes under the J-TEXT divertor configuration to generate electric fields in the plasma and drive E×B drift is analyzed. Results show that the radial electric field is dominant, and the corresponding E×B drift is poloidal. A hybrid bias mode exhibits promising potential in widening the scrape-off layer (SOL) and eliminating poloidal asymmetry.

articleTitle: Transient Control Strategy for Dual-Bridge Series Resonant Converter Under Discontinuous Conduction Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Dual-bridge series resonant converter (DBSRC) under discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) can greatly improve the efficiency under light load and achieve wide voltage gain range. However, when the transmission power command is changed abruptly during the control process, a transient process will appear in the resonant cavity, which limits the converter's control performance. This paper analyzes the phenomenon and points out the mechanism of transient bias. On this basis, a control approach is introduced to address the transient behavior under DCM, effectively mitigating the transient overshoot at the end of half a switching period and significantly improving the control performance of DBSRC. Finally, the performance of the proposed control strategy is verified by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Establishment of Electrical Equipment on Site Remote Calibration System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Quite a lot of electrical equipment such as MOA arresters cannot undergo periodic calibration in a timely manner due to power supply reliability requirements. To solve the above problems, this article establishes an online calibration system for MOA surge arresters with reverse cancellation injection based on the principle of magnetic force balance, and constructs a remote calibration architecture. The implementation of the above technology enables calibration personnel to obtain on-site calibration data from different locations in the laboratory, effectively solving the problem of inability to calibrate MOA arresters under working conditions and improving calibration efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimizing Economic Dispatch of Integrated Electric-Hydrogen Systems Considering Shared Hydrogen Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: To efficiently consume renewable energy, energy storage technology has become crucial due to its high flexibility. In our research, a basic model for energy shared hub (ESH) which contained electric-hydrogen coupling is established to analyze the economics of its integration into industrial user groups (IUGs). The validity of the proposed model in this research is proved through a practical example. The findings demonstrate that the introduction of ESH not only mitigates the wastage of sustainable energy but also significantly reduces the operating costs for users by configuring independent energy storage within IUGs.

articleTitle: A Constant Power Discharge Strategy for Flywheel Energy Storage System Based on Maximum Torque Per Ampere
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Flywheel energy storage system (FESS) possesses advantages such as rapid response, high frequency operation, and long lifespan, making it widely used in grid frequency regulation and uninterrupted power supply. To maintain a stable DC bus voltage during the discharge phase, FESS typically employs an outer-loop DC voltage control on the machine-side converter. However, this control method fails to meet the power response requirements for grid frequency regulation. This study introduces a control strategy that combines outer loop power control with Maximum Torque per Ampere (MTPA) control on the machine-side converter. This approach not only meets the power response requirements but also increases the depth of discharge, thereby fulfilling the needs of grid frequency regulation. Additionally, the grid-side converter utilizes outer loop DC voltage control to ensure DC bus voltage stabilization. The effectiveness of this control strategy is validated through simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Torque Ripple Suppression of PMSM Based on IP+QPR Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSMs) are widely used in servo systems due to their high efficiency, high power density, high reliability, and simple structure. However, when operating at low speeds, the motor torque experiences significant ripples due to external disturbances, increased nonlinear effects in the system, and limitations in the resolution of position sensors. These torque ripples affect the system's stability during low-speed operation. This paper addresses the periodic torque ripples caused by load fluctuations, friction torque variations, cogging torque, electromagnetic torque, and inverter dead-time effects at low speeds. To suppress these torque ripples, we propose an integrated control strategy combining an Integral Proportional (IP) controller with a Quasi-Proportional Resonant (QPR) controller. Compared to traditional control schemes, this combined approach significantly enhances the suppression of torque ripples, optimizing the performance of PMSMs, especially during low-speed operations. This method reduces speed ripples by approximately 82%, thereby improving both the steady-state and dynamic performance of the servo system at low speeds.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement and Key Technologies of Distributed Fault Diagnosis System for Overhead Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The distributed line fault diagnostic device is suitable for aerial transmission lines from 35kV to 1000kV and plays a significant role in the maintenance of the lines after fault occurrences. Although this system has been applied to some extent in the power production field, it still faces issues such as poor power supply stability, difficulty in capturing micro-small amplitude abnormal discharge traveling waves, loss of large original fault waveform files due to their size, and the inability to deploy devices in areas without 4G networks. These issues severely affect the stable operation of the distributed line fault diagnostic device. This paper proposes reasonable and feasible solutions to the aforementioned problems and describes the specific technical routes for implementing these solutions. The resolution of these issues has effectively improved the overall performance of the device during actual operation.

articleTitle: An Optimized Design of Active Current Source Driver for Mitigating Overshoot and Reducing Switching Losses in SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Gate driver techniques are crucial for managing the switching process of wide bandgap (WBG) semiconductor devices. Unlike voltage source gate drivers, current source gate drivers reduce switching losses by maintaining a relatively constant current during the gating process. However, this advantage is counterbalanced by increased overshoot, oscillation, and electromagnetic interference (EMI) noise. To address these challenges, an optimal active current source gate driver (ACSD) is proposed that meets the conflicting requirements of low switching losses and suppression of overshoot and oscillation by dynamically adjusting the driver current level. The effectiveness of this technique is demonstrated through both theoretical analysis and simulation validation.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Double Fed Vernier Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, based on the magnetic field modulation theory, a Double Fed Vernier Machine (DFVM) is proposed based on a regular doubly-fed machine (DFM). The magnetic field modulation process of the DFVM is explained and the stator slotting parameters of the motor are optimized with a multi-objective optimization based on multi-objective genetic algorithm. The proposed DFVM is simulated and compared with two regular DFMs. It is found that the DFVM exhibits higher average torque and higher efficiency at large excitation current, which is suitable for heavy-load applications.

articleTitle: DC Bus Voltage Feedback Based Resonance Suppression for Electrolytic Capacitor-Less Drive Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In order to mitigate grid-side current harmonics, a DC bus voltage feedback based virtual damping method for motor control in electrolytic capacitorless systems is proposed in this paper. Firstly, according to transfer function analysis, the virtual damping method with different configurations is thoroughly investigated, revealing the distortions in bus voltage and motor phase currents that are triggered by LC resonance between filter inductance and film capacitor. To solve the issue, a new bus voltage feedback method is developed. In this way, a damping current is generated, and the corresponding damping voltage is injected into the driver through the principle of minimum perturbation, where the equivalent damping can be achieved. The proposed method eliminates the need for a DC bus current sensor and the distortion of the DC bus voltage can be substantially reduced. Simulations are performed to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Real-time State Prediction Based Coordinated Control Strategy of LIQHYSMES
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: LIQHYSMES (Liquid hydrogen with superconducting magnetic energy storage) offers rapid response, substantial capacity, and low energy conversion losses, making it ideal for large scale renewable energy integration and power grid stability. However, challenges remain in fully coordinated utilization of the storage units and safe, stable operation of the storage magnets. Accurate state prediction and control are vital for the efficient operation and coordination of LIQHYSMES. This paper proposes a state prediction based LIQHYSMES coordinated control strategy. Firstly, a superconducting magnet state prediction model based on the random forest algorithm is established. Secondly, the coordinated control strategy is outlined. Finally, simulation analysis validates the prediction model and control strategy, demonstrating their accuracy and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Three-Vector-Based Optimizing Selection Model Predictive Direct Dower Control for DFIM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This article introduces a three-vector based optimizing selection model predictive direct power control (TVOS-MPDPC) method is proposed for a doubly-fed induction motor (DFIM) in the all-electric ship application with fast determining duty cycle. In the proposed method, the voltage and flux equations are redesigned to calculate the inverse of the stator-side complex power's phase. In this way, three optimal voltage vectors could be selected to eliminate power errors completely. As a result, only one prediction is necessary and seteting against the established finite-control-set model predictive control approach, the prediction time is reduced. The vector relationship diagram constructed by the selected voltage vector can be leveraged for calculate the action time and duty cycle of each voltage. The simulation results indicate the TVOS-MPDPC can greatly shorten time of forecast and significantly improve the steady-state and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Sensorless Position Estimation Method for SRM with Anti-Magnetic Saturation Capability Based on Inductance Vector Online Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a method for estimating the position of a switched reluctance motor without sensors, utilizing online identification of the inductance vector, where the rotor position estimation error caused by the electromagnetic saturation effect can be eliminated by the developed online inductance identification method. Considering the operating characteristics of the SRM, the three-phase winding will not be saturated at the same time. On this basis, this paper proposes a new position calculation method, which eliminates the influence of the relative position estimation error caused by the saturated inductance. For the SRM in the saturated operating state, the rotor position information can be given more accurately, and an inductance information does not need to be stored offline. The proposed method's effectiveness is validated through simulation, which provides a feasible solution for SRM rotor position information estimation under magnetic saturation.

articleTitle: Development of a Field-Reversed Configuration Plasma Thruster Prototype Driven by Pulsed Rotating Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The field-reversed configuration (FRC) plasma thruster driven by rotating magnetic field (RMF), abbreviated as the RMF-FRC thruster, is a promising plasma propulsion technology that theoretically has high specific impulse and high efficiency. It utilizes RMF to generate an azimuthal current in the plasma, thereby forming FRC. The FRC is then accelerated and ejected to generate a thrust through the Lorentz force produced by the plasma current and the radial component of the bias magnetic field. This paper introduces the development of a pulsed RMF-FRC thruster prototype. Pulsed discharge tests of RMF system were conducted, resulted in a damped oscillating current with a peak current of 2 kA and oscillation frequency of 210 kHz. The energy coupling efficiency of RMF system was measured to be approximately 42%. The largest plasma density was up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.28 \times 10^{19}\mathrm{m}^{-3}$</tex>. A high-speed camera captured images of the formation and ejection of plasmoid.

articleTitle: A Power Enhancement Method for Electric Field Energy Harvesting System Based on Resonant Compensation and Mutual Inductor Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The electric field energy harvesting (EFEH) system based on the line voltage features unique power supply stability for secure and reliable power supply to state monitoring sensors. However, its application is limited by the low power output. Increasing the equivalent impedance to enhance power output is an effective approach. Nonetheless, existing methods have limitations in analyzing and optimization impedance conversion and neglect the influence of the equivalent series resistance on the power enhancement. To address this, this work investigates the power enhancement method for EFEH system based on resonant compensation and optimized mutual inductor. Firstly, the influence of resonant compensation and winding parameters on system output power is well analyzed. Then, an optimization method for enhancing power by optimizing mutual inductor parameters is proposed, where the optimal values of coil turn distribution are designed to achieve high power output. Finally, a prototype is developed based on the proposed method for testing. Experimental results demonstrate that with a given magnetic core size and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$100\mu\mathrm{A}$</tex> displacement current, the optimized output power can reach 26mW, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Aggregation Black-Start Source Considering Distributed Resource
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the large-scale grid integration of renewable energy sources, distributed power sources are difficult to meet the black start requirements due to low inertia and small capacity. For this reason, this paper investigates the black start of distributed renewable energy units and small hydropower units with cooperative participation. Based on the frequency response model, we study the black start strategy of power system considering virtual synchronization control. Simulations based on the IEEE14 node system show that: small hydropower units and renewable energy units cooperatively participate in the black-start process with stable frequency response and meets the security requirements.

articleTitle: Island-Oriented Multi-Energy Reef Pan Power Plant and Its Application - Layout Optimization Study and Capacity Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In response to the problem of unreasonable power supply layout on islands, this paper fully evaluates the status of wind/light/wave energy resources in the island and its surrounding reef area scenarios. Then, based on bladeless wind turbines, floating solar panels and oscillating float wave energy capture devices, an integrated construction layout plan for multi-energy reef power stations was proposed. And with the maximum annual total power generation as the objective function, a layout optimization and capacity exploration model was established. The CPLEX mixed integer programming algorithm was used to solve the model example. The example results show that the construction layout plan proposed in this paper is reasonable and feasible, and has unique advantages in island scenarios.

articleTitle: Design of Large Capacity AC Low Frequency Power Supply Based on Thyristor AC-AC Frequency Conversion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
