abstract: In recent years, due to the continuous connection of high-power power electronic devices and other large capacity and nonlinear loads to the power grid, the low-frequency harmonics caused by these devices have seriously affected the power quality of the power grid. This paper proposes a design scheme for large-capacity low-frequency AC power supply based on thyristor AC/AC inverter. On the basis of controlling phase angle a, control of pulse width P was added, and a simulation model of a three-phase six pulse dual variable AC-AC frequency conversion closed-loop system was built in MATLAB/Simulink environment to verify its output effect in the thyristor AC-AC frequency conversion system. The power scheme can be used to simulate low-frequency interharmonics in the output power supply system, providing a fundamental platform for conducting low-frequency interharmonics research.

articleTitle: Delay-Dependent Stability of SMIB with Two Types of Excitation Controllers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Remote signals become available for designing a wide-area controllers in power system which introduces time delays into the control loop from the latency of communication networks. Moreover, fault of measurement sensors for local signals can be converted to delays in the signal measurement loop. This paper examines the stability of power systems with time delay by calculating the delay margin, which represents the maximum delay a system can tolerate before becoming unstable, considering delays from two sources. A stability criterion, utilizing Lyapunov theory and linear matrix inequalities, is proposed to calculate the delay margin for both constant and time-varying delays. Case studies focus on a single-machine infinite-bus (SMIB) power system with various exciters, such as AVR and AVR+PSS exciter controllers. Comparison the impact of time delays for different excitation controllers and relationship between the controller gains and delay margin are addressed. Accuracy of delay margin calculated is demonstrated by simulation studies, which also compare the delay tolerance of different exciters.

articleTitle: Voltage Imbalance Compensation for Unbalanced Local Load Under Weak Grid Though Three-Phase Four-Leg Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Under weak grid, three-phase unbalanced local load will lead to serious voltage imbalance at the point of common coupling (PCC). This will result in the fault or damage of local load. Three-phase four-leg inverter can provide a zero-sequence current path for unbalanced load, thus can compensate for load imbalance. In this paper, three-phase four-leg inverter is used in the power condition system working under weak grid, which is controlled to balance the PCC voltage caused by unbalanced local loads and simultaneously to lower the battery discharge. Firstly, through the separate control of the positive and negative sequence components of PCC voltage, balanced PCC voltage is achieved under unbalanced load. Furthermore, zero-sequence current is controlled to not flow through the grid neutral line. Secondly, a droop control method is proposed to eliminate positive sequence active power outputting from the inverter, which can lower the discharge of the battery. Finally, simulation results verified the correctness and validity of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Single-Turn Coil Discharge Based on Electromagnetic Field-Circuit Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Single-turn coil (STC) is a destructive pulsed magnet used to generate ultra-high magnetic field beyond 100 T. In this study, a finite element simulation model of the STC based on electromagnetic field-circuit coupling is established, which not only takes into account the effects of the changes in inductance and resistance of the STC during the discharge process, but also realizes the simulation of solid-liquid phase transition of the STC. By comparing the simulation results with the experimental data, the correctness of the STC model based on electromagnetic field-circuit coupling is verified. In addition, the current density distribution and velocity distribution of the conductor, etc. during the discharge process are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Loss and Vibration Analysis of Flywheel Energy Storage Motor for UPS System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: When the flywheel energy storage motor for UPS system is running at high speed through standby, its motor loss and electromagnetic vibration will increase. In order to improve system reliability, the motor structure needs to be reasonably designed. This paper firstly analyses the working state of flywheel energy storage motor for UPS system. Secondly, the theoretical basis of loss calculation and electromagnetic vibration is summarized in detail. In addition, the influence of structural parameters such as air gap length on stator iron loss and the influence of structural parameters such as stator slot opening on electromagnetic vibration are analyzed respectively. Through the comprehensive analysis of loss and vibration, this flywheel energy storage motor can achieve the performance requirements of low loss and low vibration.

articleTitle: New Sliding Mode Control Algorithm of Magnetic Bearing Based on State Feedback Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A new sliding mode control method based on state feedback decoupling is introduced, which solves the problem of poor decoupling control effect of traditional control strategy on active magnetic bearing (AMB). In this paper, magnetic bearing system is divided into four independent subsystems by using the principle of linear state feedback. Secondly, considering the shortcomings of the traditional controller, a nonlinear nonsingular terminal sliding mode controller with terminal sliding mode is proposed. Aiming at the chattering problem in sliding mode control, an easy-to-implement sigmoid function is designed to replace the traditional discontinuous switching function. Finally, by building a simulation model and conducting simulation experiments, it is proved that the control strategy combining the above two methods can improve the control accuracy, response speed and robustness of the magnetic bearing control system.

articleTitle: Study of the Creep Behavior and Temperature Variation Influence on CuCrZr Alloy Wire's Stress-Strain Characteristics for Pulsed Magnet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The pulsed magnets for 80 T and above are usually designed as a multi-coil structure, the pulsed magnetic field generated by the outer and internal coils coordinate on time to superimpose a high-peak magnetic field. Compared with generating short-pulsed magnetic fields, in the usual operation mode of the multi-coil pulsed magnet, the pulse width and the peak magnetic field zone of the outer coil are wider, correspondingly bearing the huge electromagnetic stress for a longer time, and the temperature rises more. However, stress maintenance and temperature variation may affect the mechanical properties of conductors. In this paper, the creep behavior of the CuCrZr wire, which is used for winding the outer coil, is tested under several stresses. Then, the stress-strain curve at multiple temperatures is tested. Finally, a small magnet wound with the wire is tested through repeated discharge at different voltage levels, and its inductance variety is analyzed.

articleTitle: Low-Voltage Ride-Through Method for Grid-Forming Converter Based on Adaptive Virtual Impedance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Due to the good weak grid adaptability and grid support capability, Grid-Forming (GFM) energy storage converter is considered to be an effective solution for the grid-connected interface of new power systems. When a symmetrical low-voltage fault occurring, grid-forming converters may face transient overcurrent problems during the fault and recovery phases. A virtual synchronous generator (VSG)-controlled GFM converter is take as the research object in this paper and a low-voltage ride-through (LVRT) control method of GFM converter is proposed, which realizes the current limitation of GFM converter under low-voltage fault by using adaptive virtual impedance. On the basis of guaranteeing the voltage source characteristics of GFM converter, L VRT control method injects reactive current into the grid according to standards. Finally, based on the Simulink/Matlab simulation platform, the effectiveness of L VRT control method for transient current suppression is verified.

articleTitle: Signature Identification of False Data Injection Attacks Based on Deep Vision Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The increasing integration of cyber-physical systems has markedly amplified the vulnerability of power systems to False Data Injection Attacks (FDIAs), posing significant threats to their security and reliability. FDIAs can emulate various power system dynamics, each with distinct objectives, potentially leading to incorrect decisions by operators or causing damage that may go undetected initially. The impact of these attacks often hinges on their specific signatures, which reflect the temporal characteristics of the injected data waveforms. Therefore, precise classification of these attack signatures is essential for predicting their potential effects and devising effective countermeasures. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing the use of the VGG16 network, a deep learning model commonly utilized in computer vision, to classify the attack signatures. Leveraging VGG16's ability to identify complex patterns in data, the pro-posed method offers a robust solution for distinguishing between different types of FDIAs. Experimental validation on the IEEE 39-bus system confirms the effectiveness of this approach in improving the detection and classification of FDIAs.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Multiple Grid-Connected Battery Energy Storage Systems with A Distributed Cooperative Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) plays a crucial role in the integration of renewable energy by balancing supply and demand, providing frequency regulation, and supporting voltage stability. However, for multiple grid-connected BESS systems, traditional power control methods, which focus on the dynamics of individual BESS, often neglect the interactions between BESSs. It results in idle power capacity and slow response times during transient events. To address these issues, a distributed cooperative control strategy based on a consensus algorithm has been proposed to improve the overall system's response speed and ensure steady-state power sharing according to the state of charge (SOC). However, few researchers have conducted the stability analysis of multiple BESSs under the distributed control scheme, and the interaction has not been thoroughly investigated. This paper addresses this gap by developing an impedance model for multiple BESSs by incorporating distributed cooperative control. With the impedance model proposed, the superiority of the BESSs with distributed cooperative control is demonstrated through a stability analysis comparison with traditional power control methods. Additionally, the study examines the impact of distributed cooperative control parameters and communication faults on the system stability. Simulations are conducted to validate the developed impedance model and the stability analysis results.

articleTitle: A Virtual Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation Based on Multi-Vector Synthesis for Neutral Point Clamped Three-Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The neutral-point clamped (NPC) three-level inverters has been widely researched and adopted in industry, for the advantages of better output waveform quality and lower voltage stress. Using the conventional virtual space vector pulse width modulation (VSVPWM) method, the neutral point (NP) could be kept stabilized and balanced over the full range of power factors or modulation indices. However, the traditional VSVPWM method requires complicated sector identification and computation. In this paper, we propose a novel virtual vector modulation based on multi-vector synthesis. Through a novel division of the space vector diagram, this method effectively reduces the number of space vector sectors. With the reasonable vector sequence, this method not only maintains the neutral current at zero but also ensures the smoothness of the output voltage waveforms. Thus, this modulation effectively decreases the computational effort while keeping the balance of the NP potential. Finally, the experimental results verified the efficacy of the modulation method and the equilibrium of the NP potential.

Author Keywords: virtual space vector pulse width modulation

articleTitle: Multivariate Evaluation and Enhancement Methods of the Hosting Capacity of Distributed Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Distributed photovoltaic (DPV), represented by household rooftop PV, has been developing rapidly under the promotion of county-wide rooftop PV policy in China. However, its large-scale integration has brought serious challenges to the reliability of the distribution network. It is of great significance to scientifically evaluate the hosting capacity of DPV and provide hosting capacity improvement strategies. By constructing distribution network operational reliability evaluation indexes, the maximum hosting capacity of DPV is evaluated by considering several factors, such as power flow, bus voltage, new energy consumption, etc. The DPV capacity is dispersed evenly to each distribution network bus, which more accurately simulates the dense distribution scenario of household PV and improves the accuracy of the hosting capacity results. A demand response (DR) model based on a two-layer game between load aggregators and distribution network operators is constructed, and the results of the calculation show that the maximum hosting capacity of DPV can be effectively improved based on guaranteeing the maximum interests of both parties. This research provides a scientific basis for the rational planning of the construction scale of DPV.

Author Keywords: the hosting capacity of distribution networks

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Diagnosis Method for Bearing Fault Using Harmonics of Stator Current
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Most of the diagnosis methods for the asynchronous motor bearing faults are based on vibration signals. However, vibration signals require additional sensors and extra space for installation. In this paper, a data-driven method for asynchronous motor bearing fault diagnosis based on stator current is proposed. The harmonics of stator current are extracted as features after processing by wavelet denoising and quasi-synchronous sampling algorithm, and the mapping relationship between features and labels is obtained by random vector functional link. The experimental test results show that the algorithm can accurately distinguish healthy bearings and inner race faulty bearings or outer race faulty bearings under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Three-Level Space Vector Modulation Method for Common-Mode Voltage Suppression
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Three-level Neutral-Point-Clamped (NPC) topology are extensively utilized in motor drive applications. However, two prevalent issues associated with Three-level NPC inverters are neutral-point (NP) fluctuations and common-mode voltage (CMV) suppression. To address these problems, an improved modulation strategy is proposed that effectively mitigates NP voltage imbalance and CMV. This strategy achieves CMV suppression by selecting vectors that produce smaller CMV for vector synthesis. For the NP voltage balance, it employs the selection of either a P/N type vectors while adjusting the action time of these vectors. Compared to traditional space vector pulse-width modulation (SVPWM) strategies, this approach simultaneously reduces NP voltage deviation and CMV. Furthermore, the expression for neutral-point current under this modulation strategy is derived, providing a practical method for the design of DC-side capacitors in three-level NPC inverters.

articleTitle: A Co-Optimization Method of Coil and Circuit in Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper proposes a co-optimization method of coil and circuit for enhancing the repetitive discharge performance of transcranial magnetic stimulation systems. Existing Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) device optimizations tend to focus solely on coils or circuits performance, neglecting the interaction between them. With the aim of reducing coil heating and improving repetitive discharge performance. This paper establishes a comprehensive computational model considering the coupling relationship between the coil and the circuit. Using a particle swarm optimization algorithm, the coil structure is optimized with the goal of reducing the energy loss per discharge, while satisfying specific coil performance criteria. The results show that, compared to existing coils, the optimized coil achieves a 54.51 % reduction in energy loss per discharge with the same target electromagnetic field intensity and a 25.85% decrease in required capacitor voltage, resulting in a higher repetitive discharge frequency. This method provides a new approach for the design and optimization of TMS systems.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network Equipment Fault Correlation Mining Model Based on the FFI-Miner Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the continuous development of the distribution network, its structure becomes increasingly complex, and the requirements for reliability rise accordingly. Meteorological conditions are one of the primary factors affecting the reliability of the distribution network. Therefore, investigating the correlation under extreme climatic conditions and implementing targeted improvements based on the findings is beneficial for the safe and stable operation of the distribution network. This paper proposes a “Meteorology-Equipment” fault correlation mining model for the distribution network. Firstly, the EWM-AHP algorithm is used to select the most relevant correlation factors and build a fault correlation feature database. Secondly, fuzzy set theory and the FFI-Miner algorithm are introduced, and membership functions for various meteorological factors are established, proposing a method for constructing the fault correlation model. Finally, a case study using data from a specific area of the State Grid is conducted, and the results validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Edge Agent Terminal in Non-Public Network Area Based on Multi-Parameter Data Fusion Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The construction of transmission line communication networks is relatively lagging behind, with some areas lacking public network signal coverage. The value mining of existing communication resources is not deep enough, and limited by the mode of power access, the monitoring device is prone to offline issues, resulting in blind spots in the monitoring area of transmission lines in areas without public networks. In order to address the issue of monitoring data transmission in these blind spots and unmanned areas for transmission line monitoring, this paper proposes a wireless AD network technology with low power wake-up for body and channel environment monitoring of transmission lines in areas without public networks, combined with multi-parameter data fusion. The device allows for automatic access of various wireless sensors and can pre-assess meteorological disaster risks on the transmission line. It can then transmit meteorological disaster information from areas without public networks to a remote operation and maintenance platform. Through testing, it has been demonstrated that the terminal can automatically wake up the networking module for data transmission based on results from multi-parameter data fusion analysis.

articleTitle: A Novel SVPWM Strategy With Model Prediction Torque Control of Six-Phase Open-Winding PMSM Considering the Nonsinusoidal Back-EMF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Compared with ordinary three-phase motor, multiphase open-winding motor has higher DC voltage utilization and output power, so it is well-suited for high-power drive applications. However, there are few researches on multiphase open-winding motors at present, in which model predictive current control(MPCC) is the main focus. However, in the applications requiring high dynamic response speed such as marine propulsion, The model predictive torque control(MPTC) is more suitable for application scenario, and the influence of non-sinusoidal back-electromotive force(EMF) on multiphase open-winding motor control system is rarely considered. Therefore, this article takes the six-phase open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor(SOW-PMSM) as the research object and establishes a complete control system of the multiphase open winding motor. Firstly, the paper analyzes the harmonic generation mechanism of the motor and derives the effects of non-sinusoidal back-EMF and inverter dead time on the motor. It then establishes a mathematical model of the SOW-PMSM that takes into account harmonic in permanent magnet(PM) flux linkage and based on this mathematical model, the reference voltage required by Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) is obtained by using the deadbeat torque control. In addition, a new SVPWM strategy is proposed by using the abundant voltage vectors of the six H-bridge inverters. By using multiple effective vectors, the motor can achieve a high DC voltage utilization while the harmonic plane vector synthesis is zero. Finally, the rationality of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation.

Author Keywords: six-phase open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor(SOW-PMSM)

articleTitle: A New Energy Multi-Station Short-Circuit Ratio Online Calculation Method Based on Message Passing GCNConv
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: At present, the short-circuit ratio constraint of multi-station is incorporated into the new energy operation limit check by offline calculation, without considering the influence of new energy power distribution and topological structure on the short-circuit ratio. To solve this problem and implement the online calculation, this paper introduces a new graph neural network framework, called the online short-circuit ratio calculation method of new energy multi-station based on message passing GCNConv. Based on the accuracy guarantee, this method can process the graph structure data of the power system, and through the message passing mechanism, the information of nodes and edges can be efficiently aggregated and disseminated, and the real-time online calculation efficiency can be improved. Finally, the performance of the model is verified by the simulation and comparative analysis of the 109-node system.

articleTitle: Redundant Strategy of T-Type DC/DC MMC Based on Third Harmonic Injection for Submodule Failure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, an endogenous AC optimization strategy for T-type topology DC/DC MMC(TDC-MMC) is proposed and applied to the protection strategy for sub-module faults. The endogenous AC model of TDC-MMC is established under the dq coordinate system. Based on this model, two endogenous AC strategies are derived under the conditions of loss minimization and voltage minimization, respectively. The optimization of endogenous AC is achieved by further introducing the third harmonic and redefining the voltage vector relationship under the minimum voltage condition. The optimal amplitude and phase of the third harmonic for each bridge arm are then determined. In a simulation of a 3 kV/1 kV DC transmission system, the working principle of the strategy is verified by applying the protection strategy to the sub-module fault cases of the HV Arm, MV Arm and LV Arm.

articleTitle: Complex Power Quality Disturbance Classification Based on Fuzzy Transfer Field and DPN-17
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Disturbances of power quality in modern power systems tend to be complicated due to the diversification of electrical equipment and the complexity of equipment working conditions. Traditional classification methods are difficult to meet the classification requirement of multiple power quality disturbances (PQDs). In this paper, a hybrid power quality disturbance classification method based on fuzzy transfer field and DPN-17 is proposed. Fuzzy transfer field is a conversion scheme proposed to solve the confusion problem in the process of amplitude-dependent signal transformation in the existing mainstream dimension conversion methods. Fuzzy idea is used to blur the specific coordinates of signal points, and precisely encode the timing relationship and distribution of signal points, so that it can effectively encode the timing relationship and distribution information of signals. It can retain the features well in the process of downsampling; DPN-17 is implemented by referring to the shallow residual network model and using dual-path neural network modular fast combination stack. Simulation and experiments show that the proposed method can effectively solve the confusion problem of dimension conversion schemes, and can achieve accurate and rapid identification of complex power quality disturbances with an accuracy rate of 97.40%.

articleTitle: Magnet and Tracking Analysis of Quadrupole Scanning Method for Emittance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Since transverse emittance serves as a critical parameter for evaluating the performance of an electron-beam injector, accurate emittance measurement directly affects the engineering realization of not only the injector but also the entire accelerator-based facility involved. Based on the typical beam injector developed at Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST injector), the quadrupole magnet scanning (Q-scanning) method is employed for emittance measurement. Suitable selections are made for the existing devices within the beamline, which reduce the measurement errors associated with emittance. An analysis is conducted on the selected quadrupole magnets (Q-magnets), along with an examination of the impact of fringe fields on emittance measurements, including the effects of different edge field conditions and the direct representation of fringe fields in the transfer matrix. The analysis results clearly demonstrate the importance of device selection in the Q-scanning method and the direct effects of fringe fields on various aspects.

articleTitle: Impact of Electron Beam Energy and Dose on the Microstructure and Performance of e-PDMS-TEP Coatings
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The energy and dose of electron beam (EB) are crucial in the process design of EB curing. Taking the e-PDMS-TEP coating on Q235 steel surface as an example, this study, combined with Monte Carlo simulation and experimental validation, investigates the crosslinking characteristics of the coating under energy ranges of 100 to 200 keV and doses of 0 to 800 kGy. The findings reveal that the coating can be effectively cured within a range of energy from 200 ke V to 160 ke V, with the necessary dose escalating as energy decreases. However, excessive energy may lead to coating degradation, whereas insufficient energy might result in incomplete curing. The simulation outcomes provide partial guidance for EB process design.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Li-Ion Batteries by Multi-modal Attention Fusion Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are crucial for electric vehicles and smart grids, yet their performance degrades with charge-discharge cycles, leading to reduced capacity and increased resistance. Predicting the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) is essential for preventing failures and ensuring stable operation. However, estimating RUL is challenging due to its indirect measurability and the influence of various factors such as battery components, packaging processes, and operating conditions. This paper presents a Multimodal Attention Fusion Neural Network (MAFN) to forecast battery health and RUL using historical data. Trained on a diverse electrochemical dataset with various battery components and cycling conditions, the model integrates battery materials and electrical signals, capturing critical aging features for accurate RUL prediction. This approach advances rapid RUL estimation, enhancing battery management systems and supporting smart grid and carbon neutrality goals.

articleTitle: Multi-physics Filed Coupling Design of High-speed Permanent Magnet Machine for Electric Turbocharging
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Electric turbochargers are one of the most cost-effective products for enhancing fuel efficiency in both conventional fuel vehicles (CFVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs). Benefiting from the increasingly stringent trend of energy conservation and emission reduction, it is predicted that the installation rate of turbochargers will continue to increase in the future. To address the issues of poor calculation accuracy during high-speed operation of electric turbocharger machines, this paper focuses on a 3.2kW and 60,000r/min high-speed permanent magnet synchronous machine (HS-PMSM) for electric turbocharger as the research object. It conducts a study on the multi-physics field coupling design method encompassing the electromagnetic, thermal, stress, and rotor dynamics. This research reveals the coupling mechanisms between various physical fields within the HS-PMSM, further enhancing the machine reliability and performance. Firstly, the working principle of the electric turbocharger machine system is elaborated, and the machine structure and key parameters are presented. Secondly, based on the bidirectional magnetic-thermal coupling method, the machine losses and temperature are studied. Furthermore, the temperature-stress coupling and rotor dynamics of the HS-PMSM are investigated to obtain the variation of the rotor strength under different operating conditions. Finally, a prototyped HS-SPMSM is manufactured and a testing platform is built, where the performance and feasibility of the machine are verified through experiments.

articleTitle: A Novel Model Predictive Control with Double Virtual Vector Modulation to Suppress Common Mode Voltage in Three-Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In this paper, the mathematical models of neutral point voltage (NPV) and cmv are analyzed. A novel model prediction (MPC) control strategy is proposed to suppress the common-mode voltage (CMV) of a three-level inverter using the modulation technique of virtual two-vectors. The strategy reduces current ripple and THD by constructing virtual vectors. Each virtual vector with low cmv amplitude also has the ability to regulate the NPV balance. Finally, this paper verifies that the algorithm has good results in output waveform quality, (total harmonic distortion) THD, NPV fluctuation, and cmv stability through simulation results.

articleTitle: A Voltage Level Design Method for Direct Current Autotransformer Based Medium Voltage Direct Current Traction Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Due to the improved power supply capability, the medium voltage direct current (MVDC) traction power supply system (TPSS) based on the direct current autotransformer (DCAT) has become a promising solution for future electrified railways. However, as the heart of DCAT-based MVDC TPSS, the voltage level still lacks a systematic design method. To address this issue, this paper presents a comprehensive voltage level design method. The key metrics including voltage fluctuation, stray current, rail potential, traction network temperature, and economy are all considered and modeled. Then, the design process of voltage level is provided with a specific case study. A simulation model is built and the results prove the effectiveness of the proposed voltage level design method.

articleTitle: Study on Control Strategy of Wind Farms for Rapid Response to Grid Dispatch Instructions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In a centralized control architecture, wind farms often require the participation of wind turbines when facing voltage drops at the grid connection point or a lack of reactive power support. However, if wind turbines directly participate in reactive power support, the delay in solving reactive power commands can result in a lag in the response of the wind farm. The control layer of the wind farm responds slowly when achieving optimization goals, failing to meet the response speed requirements needed by the higher-level control. Additionally, this delay increases with the scale of the wind farm, further exacerbating the lag in responding to grid dispatch instructions. This paper proposes a control strategy for wind farms to rapidly respond to grid dispatch instructions. Upon receiving a grid dispatch instruction, reactive power compensation devices are prioritized to quickly provide reactive power. Once the system stabilizes, the reactive power compensation tasks are transferred to the wind turbines. A simulation model of a real wind farm is established in Matlab/Simulink to verify that the proposed control strategy can effectively improve the response speed of the wind farm.

articleTitle: Adaptive State-of-Charge Control Strategy for Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on Grid-Forming Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: At present, Grid-Forming (GFM) control is recognized as the most promising control technology for grid-connected converters. The energy the GFM converters provide for grid frequency support is mainly sourced from energy storage (ES). Hybrid Energy Storage (HES) systems have the potential to combine the advantages of different types of ES, thereby enhancing the frequency response and inertia emulation capabilities. Nevertheless, ES may encounter State-of-Charge (SOC) limit issues in practice. This paper focuses on the control of the HES system based on GFM converter (GFM-HES). An adaptive SOC control strategy is proposed. On the one hand, closed-loop control of the Supercapacitor terminal voltage is employed to achieve fast SOC recovery. On the other hand, adaptive SOC control for the battery is adopted to prevent it from entering the overcharge and over-discharge zone. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on grounding network fault diagnosis method based on improved Northern Goshawk Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The grounding network plays an important role in the power system for voltage equalisation and current discharge, however, because it is often buried in the ground, its fault detection becomes very difficult, which brings serious hidden danger to the safe operation of the power system. Therefore, accurate diagnosis of faults in the grounding network is of great significance to the stable operation of the power system. Based on the current research situation at home and abroad, this paper establishes a mathematical model for grounding network corrosion diagnosis, and proposes a grounding network fault diagnosis method based on the improved Northern Goshawk Optimisation algorithm. In addition, this paper also takes a 110 kV actual grounding network as an example, and carries out a simulation analysis for the corrosion of grounding network branches. The results show that the improved Northern Goshawk Optimisation algorithm can accurately identify the location of faults, providing a theoretical basis for the development of power system fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Observer-Based Feedforward Compensation for Additional Torque Disturbances of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The speed of the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM) fluctuates due to sudden load torque changes. The fluctuating speed has a negative impact on the performance of the system. To address this problem, an observer-based feedforward compensation method for additional load torque disturbance is proposed in this paper. First, the load torque observer is comprehensively designed with its pole configuration method proposed. Second, incomplete and complete feedforward compensation methods for disturbance rejection are analyzed. The proposed complete feedforward compensation method for disturbance rejection further reduces the effect of load torque disturbances on the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by the simulation results, which show that the proposed method effectively reduces the impact of sudden load torque changes on the speed of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Hot Spot Temperature Modeling and Forecasting Method of Oil-Immersed Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The hot spot temperature of transformer is the highest point of winding temperature during transformer operation, which directly reflects the heat load of winding and is a critical indicator for transformer safety and performance evaluation. Therefore, accurate prediction of this hot spot temperature is essential for estimating the transformer's service life, enhancing economic efficiency, and preventing significant thermal incidents. Based on the comprehensive analysis of the internal temperature rise process and temperature distribution characteristics of oil-immersed transformers, and combined with the measured data of the transformer after removing outliers, this paper develops a high-precision prediction model for hot spot temperature based on a BP neural network. Use particle group algorithm to optimize BP neural network and to further improve the accuracy and reliability of the model prediction.

articleTitle: A Pre-disaster Optimal Maintenance Strategy for Distribution Networks to Confront Severe Convective Weather Considering Post-disaster Situations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The increasingly frequent severe convective weather poses a serious threat to the reliability of distribution networks. In this regard, an optimal maintenance model that considers pre-disaster defense and post-disaster mitigation stages is proposed to meet the demand for resilience enhancement. During the pre-disaster defense stage, the equipment maintenance plan and the corresponding operation strategy are decided in conjunction with the failure probability of each device. During the post-disaster mitigation stage, the emergency dispatch strategy of the grid is developed considering the diversity of damage results. On these bases, the optimal pre-disaster maintenance strategy considering post-disaster situations is identified by integrating the two stages' outage losses and operating costs. Finally, the numerical results show that the proposed strategy can give an optimal maintenance plan by combining the fragility of each device, which effectively improves the outage prevention and management capability of the distribution network under severe convective weather.

articleTitle: Research on Loran-C Transmitting System Technology Based on Class-D Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The Objective of this study is to study a new all-solid-state Loran-C transmission technology based on Class-D power amplifiers, and to apply the research results to the “blind compensation” or “enhancement” of the positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) functions of the transmission system, as well as to guide the construction of large-scale transmission stations. The standard Loran-C waveform was theoretically analyzed, modeled and simulated, and the discrete excitation signal for three time periods was generated by pre-distortion modulation technology, and the trapezoidal voltage waveform was superimposed and synthesized by driving the Class-D power amplifiers module to load the antenna tuning network, and finally the standard Loran-C current waveform was formed on the antenna. The results solve the defects of the complex composition of the transmitter of the semi-circular magnetic pulse generator and the high dependence on hardware parameters for the waveform generation method, which makes it difficult to quickly adapt to different transmitting antennas and new systems, improve the transmission efficiency and reduce the operating cost. The Loran-C transmission technology based on Class-D power amplifiers improves the performance of the system from the aspects of new system waveform research, machine efficiency, waveform adaptability and maneuverability, which meets the requirements of the development of a new generation of long-wave navigation timing transmission system in China, and the technology has high military and social application value.

articleTitle: Control Strategy and System Operation Stability Analysis of Grid Type Direct Drive Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the proportion of wind power in the power system, improving the inertia support and frequency response capability of wind farms has become a research hotspot. This article applies the inertia synchronization control strategy and proposes a coordinated control strategy for DC networking and flexible DC systems. And a small signal model of the direct drive wind turbines grid connected system based on inertial synchronization control is established. Through eigenvalue analysis, it is found that introducing inertial synchronization control would reduce system stability. And using the “complex torque coefficient method”, the mechanism of inertia synchronization control reducing the stability of the system operation from the perspective of damping characteristics is revealed, providing guidance for the improvement of inertia synchronization control method. The effectiveness and theoretical analysis of the proposed strategy were verified through PSCAD and Matlab platforms.

Author Keywords: Grid type direct drive wind turbines

articleTitle: An Improved Third-Order Generalized Integrator Based Novel Sliding Mode Observer for Piston Stroke Estimation of Linear Oscillatory Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Linear compressors are being widely used in a huge variety of applications due to their higher efficiency than traditional rotary compressors. The linear compressor is driven by the Linear Oscillatory Machine (LOM), and the sensor-less control of LOM is very important to make linear compressors more efficient and compatible auxiliary for big systems like refrigerators, air conditioners, automatic gates etc. A novel piston stroke estimation method has been proposed in this article to obtain the sensor less control of the LOM. This method utilizes an improved third-order generalized integrator (TOGI) based novel sliding mode observer (SMO) for LOM piston stroke estimation. In addition to this, an absolute reaching law with a chosen sliding surface has been implemented to further reduce the effects of sliding chattering. The piston stroke signal suffers DC offsets and harmonics due to mismatched machine parameters, nonlinearities of the converter, and first-order integration of back-electromotive force (EMF). In some recent studies, the second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) has been used to reduce pure integral saturation problem, but it still has a limited attenuation ability against DC components and has considerable steady-state error. Therefore, in order to improve the accuracy of the estimated stroke signals, a new method has been proposed in this article, which can not only solve the integral saturation problem, but also reduce the steady-state error of the estimated piston stroke, effectively. The simulation results and the numerical analysis prove the authenticity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling of Active Suppression Technology for Radiated EMI Generated by the SMPS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Passive shielding technology is a feasible and effective suppression technology for switching-mode power supply system. However, there are some disadvantages such as low shielding effectiveness (SE) and poor selecting for frequency with current passive shielding technology. In order to cope with it, a kind of radiated EMI active cancellation technology is proposed and the model of the radiated EMI active cancellation (REAC) system is built. Finally, an experimental platform is established. The experimental results show that the proposed technical of radiated EMI active cancellation can effectively suppress radiated EMI.

articleTitle: Overview of Neutral Beam Injection Ion Source Power Supply System Using Filament Ion Soruce
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The neutral beam injection (NBI) power supply system is is crucial for the NBI system's operation, with all its components working together to ensure proper function. The NBI ion source power supply system is vital for generating and extracting ion beams, making it a key element of the NBI power system. In this paper, the NBI ion source power supply system using filament ion source will be investigated. Depending on the load, NBI ion source power supply system is divided into plasma generator power supply (filament power supply and arc power supply), ion optical system power supply (acceleration grid power supply, gradient grid divider and suppressor grid power supply) and transmission line system (transmission line, snubber and snubber bias power supply). This paper describes in detail the role, structure, characteristic, load requirement and typical application of each power supply.

articleTitle: New Negative Output Wide Voltage Gain Range Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A new negative output DC-DC converter with a wide voltage gain range is recommended in this paper. On the input side, two Boost structures are connected in parallel, and the input current is split through two inductors, thereby reducing the volume of the inductors and improving the efficiency. When charging inductor, construct a higher charging voltage to increase the voltage gain. On the output side, capacitors are discharged in series to further upgrade the voltage gain while decreasing the voltage stress on the power semiconductors. Analyses are done on the working principle, features, and design factors. A 400W prototype is developed to verify the correctness of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Phase Shielding Method Based on $\Delta\text{-Cr-Y}$ Three-Phase Interleaved LLC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Based on the Δ-Cr-Y three-phase interleaved LLC converter, a series of possible phase shielding methods are proposed, and one of them is analyzed in detail. After the phase shielding operation, the resonant frequency of the converter does not change, which means smooth switching in the field of DC transformers. But in voltage regulation applications, careful design of parameters is required because the gain characteristics of the converter change significantly. After loss analysis and comparison, the efficiency can still be improved at light load due to the reduction in volt-second product, even if the cores cannot be removed from the circuit.

articleTitle: AGC Active Participation in Low Carbon Economic Dispatch Considering Demand Response of Energy-Extensive Industrial Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The growing integration of wind power into the grid has enabled a low-cost, sustainable electricity supply but has also introduced technical challenges related to intermittency. This paper examines the issue of unit combination in power systems, and the optimization objective considers both economic costs and carbon emission costs. On the power supply side, a unit combination model considering the active participation of automatic generation control (AGC) in regulating wind power fluctuations is proposed to ensure the stability of the power system. Compared with some existing models, this model introduces the AGC regulation model and enriches the power supply side regulation means. On the load side, industrial loads are considered to participate in demand-side response, which increases system flexibility and can work with thermal power units to cope with the randomness of new energy sources. Finally, the proposed model is tested in IEEE 24-RTS node system. The simulation results illustrate that our model can better utilize wind power and effectively achieve low-carbon economic dispatch.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Armature-Rail Electrical Contact Under Multi-Physics Field Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The electromagnetic rail launcher works under the extremely harsh impact conditions involving the coupling of multiple physical fields such as extremely strong electromagnetic fields, extremely high thermal fields, and extremely high force fields. The touch state between aluminum alloy armature and steel guide rail is related to the output performance, response stability, operating efficiency, work reliability, and high energy consumption of the entire system, and the pulse current and the interface roughness have a significant effect on the contact state. An experimental platform for electromagnetic rail launching is built, and the rifling voltage, rail current and contact resistance are measured experimentally. A multi-physical field coupled armature-rail electric contact model is constructed, and the distribution laws of current density, temperature and magnetic flux density of the armature and guideway are analysed. Furthermore, the effects of current amplitude and friction factor on its dynamic characteristics and temperature and magnetic flux density are investigated. The results indicate that there is an initial peak in both the pulse current and the bore voltage, which decays after the armature exits the bore. The high-temperature and strong magnetic region of the system is located at the metal contact interface. The speed and force vary significantly with the amplitude and roughness of the current.

articleTitle: Development of an Integrated Monitoring System for Conductor Temperature and Sag in Power Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The temperature sag of transmission line conductors is a key indicator in the design and operation of power transmission lines. Excessive sag not only poses safety hazards but also limits the transmission capacity of the lines. Due to the increasing demand for electricity consumption, many existing transmission lines have increased the maximum allowable operating temperature of the conductors from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$70^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$80^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex> to enhance their transmission capacity. This necessitates the verification or real-time monitoring of sag to ensure the safety of line operation and the equipment being crossed. This paper focuses on the measurement of conductor temperature and sag, and develops an integrated monitoring system for the temperature sag of transmission line conductors. From the development of monitoring terminals to the design of data links, and then to the construction of the overall system, it achieves real-time monitoring of the sag and temperature of overhead lines.

articleTitle: Design of High-Power Electronic Converters Based on Iterative and Optimization Flowchart
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy technologies, high-power power electronic converters are playing an increasingly vital role in power systems. Currently, the design of high-power converters is mostly customized, heavily reliant on the engineering experience of designers, and susceptible to waste of expensive equipment due to design oversights. This paper proposes a standardized design process for high-power converters to improve design efficiency and reduce trial-and-error costs. It first outlines the key steps in the design of high-power converters, including performance analysis, topology selection, parameter and component design, structural and thermal performance checks, and preliminary performance testing. It then describes the iterative optimization process within each design phase. Finally, based on this process, a 200kW DC/DC high-power converter prototype was designed and passed all basic performance tests, demonstrating the practicality and effectiveness of the proposed design process and facilitating the move towards automated design.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Terminal Flexible DC Distribution Line Protection Using Active Current-Limiting and Two-Stage Active Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Traditional DC protection schemes rely on transient signals captured within extremely short data windows to form fault criteria. However, these methods are susceptible to noise, measurement errors, and the influence of control switch transients. Additionally, rapid system blocking can lead to insufficient transient protection information. Addressing these limitations, this paper proposes an active current-limiting strategy and a two-stage active injection line protection scheme suitable for multi-terminal flexible DC distribution systems. This protection scheme combines local port protection with coordinated control between converters in the system. By setting current-limiting control strategies and characteristic signal injection control strategies for each port converter, the converter can limit the fault impulse current and then transform it into an injection source with characteristic signals. The injection of the first-level characteristic signal can preliminarily identify the fault location, while the second-level characteristic signal distinguishes the fault section. Compared with traditional DC protection, the proposed scheme has multiple advantages, including effective fault information after converter blocking, reduced equipment and data sampling requirements, and simple and reliable implementation. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified through simulation results using PSCAD/EMTDC software.

articleTitle: A Multi-Unit Bidirectional Inductive Power Transfer System With Power-Synchronization Controlled Subunits
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: A multi-unit bidirectional inductive power transfer (BIPT) system is suitable as a wireless energy trading platform for electric vehicles (EVs). Phase synchronization technique is required to implement flexible power flow pattern of such system. Traditional method utilizes dedicated synchronization module, which will increase the complexity and the cost of system. This article proposed a multi-unit BIPT system with power-synchronization controlled subunits. The resemblance between the multi-unit BIPT system and the traditional power grid dominated by synchronous machines is revealed. A power-synchronization method is proposed for the multi-unit BIPT system, which can significantly reduce the complexity and the cost of system because neither extra coils nor extra high-speed, high-precision detection and conditioning circuits are required. Experimental verification is carried out to verify the grid-to-vehicle (G2V) and vehicle-to-grid (V2G) capability of the multi-unit BIPT system and the effectiveness of the proposed power-synchronization method.

articleTitle: Complex Power Quality Disturbance Identification Based on GAF-MTF Three-Channel Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The diversification of equipment in power system and the complexity of operating conditions gradually lead to the development of power quality disturbance to the complex power quality disturbances(CPQDs) which is released simultaneously by multiple types of disturbance. It is important to identify the type of CPQDs reliably and effectively for the stable operation of power grid. In this paper, a CPQDs identification architecture based on GASF-GADF-MTF three-channel multi-dimensional feature fusion plus transformer is proposed. Firstly, the CPQDs singal is converted into RGB three-channel data by using Gram summing field(GASF), Gram-diff-field(GADF) and Markov-transfer-field(MTF). The two-dime image of feature fusion is obtained. Then the transformer network is used to classify and discriminate the two-dime images containing the complex power quality disturbance characteristics. Simulation results show that the proposed method is reliable and effective, and has the advantages of good noise robustness and strong generalization ability.

articleTitle: Overview of Development Trends of Rare-Earth-Less Machines for Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In recent years, there has been rapid development in the field of electric vehicles (EVs), with a steady increase in market share. Permanent magnet synchronous machines (PMSMs), particularly those employing rare-earth PMs, have emerged as the predominant choice for propulsion systems of EVs, owing to their compact size, high power density, and high efficiency. However, the persistently high and fluctuating prices of rare-earth PMs lead to the overall high cost of machines. To mitigate the cost of drive motors, this paper explores the potential of three types of rare-earth less machines: PM-assisted synchronous reluctance machines (PMaSynRMs), hybrid PM assisted synchronous reluctance machines (HPMaSynRMs), and hybrid excitation machines (HEMs). The current development, advantages, and respective challenges of these three types of machines are discussed from various perspectives. In summary, the current power density levels of these three types of machines have not yet reached those of rare-earth PMSMs. However, due to their significant cost advantage in PMs, they are likely to be suitable for new energy vehicles where the power density requirements are not as stringent.

articleTitle: A Power Cable Fire Risk Assessment Method Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: As a fundamental component in substations, power cables are abundant and widely dispersed, serving to interconnect various devices, on-site operational systems, and remote control systems within the substation. Their condition often determines the converter station's ability to operate normally. As substation construction continues to evolve, the station is faced with numerous power cables, challenges in daily operations and maintenance, and potential safety risks in fire and security. This paper initially examines the ignition mechanisms of internal fires in power cables, identifies the intrinsic factors causing their combustion, and assesses the aging state of power cables, thereby providing a basis for risk evaluation of power cable fires. Subsequently, leveraging the evaluation criteria for single-phase grounding arcs and conductor temperature, a risk assessment model for power cable fires is developed employing the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation, encompassing three dimensions: cable operational parameters, cable faults, and cable laying, to quantify the risk level of power cable fires. Through case studies, this approach enables the preemptive identification of fire risks in power cables, the proactive implementation of various measures for power cables, and consequently bolsters the safe and stable operation of the substation's underground power grid.

articleTitle: Study on the Applicability of Defect Detection Methods for Internal Voltage Balancing Capacitor Tubes in Ultra-UHV Surge Arresters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: Targeting accidents caused by the loosening or detachment of internal voltage-balancing capacitor tubes in station-used 750kV gapless metal oxide surge arresters, this paper has investigated portable partial discharge measurement methods including HFCT, UHF, ultrasonic, and oscilloscope techniques under controlled laboratory conditions simulating eight specific scenarios. The study included interference resistance trials with varying degrees and distances of ladder interference, comparing outcomes with traditional resistive current testing. It concludes by identifying field-applicable detection methods for these types of defects, enhancing the arsenal of effective on-site partial discharge measurement tools for surge arresters.

articleTitle: Simulation of Disruption Plasma Parameters for the Confinement Ability of Runaway Electrons
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: The presence of runaway electrons during the dis-ruption evolves into a runaway current, which carries a large amount of energy and will cause irreversible damage to the toka-mak device in case of an impact on the device wall, and thus re-quires attention. It is found that the plasma parameters before plasma disruption, such as the boundary safety factor, the mag-nitude of the toroidal magnetic field, and the electron density, af-fect the formation of the runaway current during the experiment, which can also be interpreted as affecting the confinement of the runaway electron seeds during thermal quench, but there is no relevant numerical simulation study yet. In this qaper, the exper-imental results are reproduced qualitatively using the NIMROD simulation code, and the runaway electron confinement during thermal quench is investigated using a test particle model. Dif-ferent parameters are found to affect the runaway electron con-finement in their respective ways.

articleTitle: Topology and Control of Repetitive Pulsed Power Supply with DC Bus-Side Power Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: In repetitive-frequency pulsed power application, capacitor is usually used as the terminal energy buffer to reduce the impact of pulsed loads on the power grid. The output capacitor voltage is repeatedly charged to the set value by the capacitor power supply (CCPS). However, the charging power of the CCPS is constantly variable, which seriously affects the waveform quality of the power grid. In this paper, a new repetitive-frequency pulsed power supply topology based on DC bus-side power compensation is proposed. For the power grid, the whole repetitive-frequency pulsed power supply can be equated to a constant resistance load. Therefore, constant power input is achieved, which helps to achieve unit power factor in the front-end power factor correction stage and reduces the impact on the power grid. And the repetitive pulse discharge frequency is increased. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed scheme are verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Partial Discharge Image Recognition of Onboard Cable Terminal Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE China International Youth Conference on Electrical Engineering (CIYCEE)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenges of difficult data acquisition and limited samples of partial discharge (PD) data from onboard cable terminals, which affect the accuracy of insulation defect classification. We propose an enhancement method for PD data from onboard cable terminals based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). Using Boundary Equilibrium GAN (BEGAN), Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN), and Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) to learn from PD image samples of onboard cable terminals, we evaluate the image generation quality of the three networks. The results show that all three networks have good generation effects on the PD images. We utilize BEGAN, DCGAN, and WGAN-GP to enhance the few-shot PD image dataset of onboard cable terminals and conduct classification training on the enhanced dataset. The results indicate that the enhanced datasets from all three generative networks can improve the accuracy of image classification, with DCGAN demonstrating the best enhancement effect.
